newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BRITISH CORPORATIONS TO VISIT TALLINN.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH CORPORATIONS TO VISIT TALLINN.

text.p: A delegation of British financial corporations will visit Tallinn next week, the British embassy said on Monday.
The delegation will include representatives from SBC Warburg Bank, NM Rothschild, Arthur Andersen, Sinclair Roche Temperley, Wilde Sapte and the Bank of America, the embassy said in a statement.
It added that former British energy minister Lord Howell will join the delegation.
The delegation will discuss with Estonia's government the privatisation of Eesti Energia (Estonian Energy) and questions related to infrastructure.
It will conduct a seminar on capital markets on Tuesday, May 20. The delegation will also meet several Estonian cabinet ministers and the president of the Estonian central bank.
